result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The environment is characterized by narrow walkways obstructed by utility poles and sightlines limited by vehicles parked close to the corners.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, providing no designated space or priority for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the intersection corner, which can hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbs near the intersection

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the center of the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective width for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all four corners to ensure accessibility for all users.
